thread.title: Charts: Should You Invest in Bitcoin or Technology Stocks?

author: thestreet.com
title: Charts: Should You Invest in Bitcoin or Technology Stocks?
text:
Should you invest in bitcoin or the stock market's hottest sector: tech?
Bitcoin prices have been quite volatile over the past three months. The high on December 16 of 19,300 has since been obliterated to 11,000 - that's a decline of 43%.
Then again, bitcoin prices were at about 1,000 a year ago.
As for technology stocks in the S&P 500, they've had a steady climb higher over the past few months - up 12%. That momentum has even continued into 2018....with tech stocks rising over 6%.
This group includes stocks like Apple ( AAPL ) , Facebook ( FB ) and Alphabet ( GOOGL ) . 
Tech stocks are pricey at 25X earnings, but the S&P 500 is trading at 23X earnings - the spread isn't that big.
Bottom line: stay diversified. You can invest in both bitcoin and tech stocks, but putting all your money in bitcoin could have a bad ending.
